# Three.js r180

These unmodified browser modules are vendored from `three@0.180.0` at
https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/ so the replay page makes no external requests.
The accompanying MIT license applies to these files.

The instrument model is a separate, ignored ChemLab asset. Restore it with
`python tools/fetch_replay_assets.py`; its existing ChemLab attribution and
licensing are in `vendor/chemlab/NOTICE.md` and `LICENSE-ASSETS.md`.
